name: Intro (match start)
notes: [match] cinematic: sent with 0x20F5 cinematic_delay (5 s) after the load-complete notice 0x1000015E; the tutorial script starts on its state-4 notice. Both paddy wagons explode in it with their own Vfx_OnExplode 0x10000079 (no variables). Layout listing attributes 01RangedA, 01MeleeA/B and 02Destroyer to it.

name: Catwoman breaks the street vehicle
notes: Sent once the practice drones are down and the queued lines are spoken (catwoman_wait_scale 0.5). Actors: Gaslight_Batman (0x2E0001B2, starts with Fidgets_Disable 0x10000320) and Gaslight_Catwoman (0x2E0007C0). The player's Batman is placed on the actor (40.687, 58.229) and hidden with 0x90F; the vehicle goes 6 s in (vehicle_break_at). Its own lines carry conversation flag 0x4000 (0x1AF, 0x357, 0x358): the server must not send them. State 4 starts part 2 (bridge.py).

name: Drone fights the thugs
notes: Not played by the server; source of the first drone's spot (Drone_01 at (34.98, 56.32)). Actors Drone_01 (0x2E001167), Thug_01 / Thug_02 (0x2E0012BB), Gaslight_Batman_01. The drone attacks with CinematicCombatBasicAttack 0x1000010F, explodes with Vfx_OnExplode 0x10000079 at frame 231; a thug plays _Defeat_OnDead 0x100001FA at 236.

name: The Destroyer arrives
notes: Sent 1 + sphere_fall_seconds after the strength drones die, once the sphere 0x2E000AC5 has dropped. Shows the Destroyer (0x2E000AB5) and four drones walking out (layout 0x1D000774: Melee1/2, Ranged1/2). Its own lines 0x1CF. The Destroyer is spawned before it (destroyer_in_cinematic). 60 s timeout if no state 4 arrives.

name: Ending: the last gate opens
notes: Sent ending_delay (1 s) after the Destroyer falls; Batman hidden as it starts. Actors GaslightBatman (0x2E0001B2), Gate (0x2E000CD7, template 0x1D000789) and PowerCore (0x2E000AC5, template 0x1D00078A). Lines 0x1BC. VICTORY billboard + 0x2038 + Cinematic_Victory at 18.5 s (victory_in_cinematic), match end at 22.6 s (match_end_in_cinematic). Earlier tried as a pre-intro 'power cores falling' cinematic (pre_cinematics).
